question: 'Indira Gandhi Shehri Rozgar Guarantee Yojana 2022' has been implemented by which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rajasthan government has come up with the job description under its much-touted Indira Gandhi Shahri Rozgar Guarantee Yojana.
 
• Announcing the employment scheme for urban areas on the lines of MGNREGA for rural areas in the budget speech
 
• While MGNREGA assists people in rural areas, there is no such scheme for street vendors, as well as those working at dhabas and restaurants in urban areas.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Indira Gandhi Shahri Rozgar Guarantee Yojana:

 
• Under the scheme, 100 days of employment per year will be provided to families residing in urban areas.
 
• The ratio of cost of material to pay for labour work of “general nature” will be in the ratio of 25:75, while for special works, it will be 75:25.

Eligibility:

 
• All those aged between 18 and 60 years and residing within urban body limits are eligible for the scheme, and in special circumstances such as a pandemic or a calamity, migrant labourers may be included.
